intro.lede: I am Peter Mwaura, an aerospace engineering graduate with a computer science minor focused on propulsion, systems engineering, testing, and technical leadership. My work spans hybrid-electric aircraft design, Design/Build/Fly, rocket systems, applied research, and hands-on prototyping.

intro.recruiterHeading: I work where analysis, build execution, and operational reality meet.
intro.recruiterBody: This portfolio is built to show more than finished outputs. It highlights how I lead technical work, decompose requirements, validate assumptions through testing, and move engineering from concept to reliable performance.

metrics.label: member team led in AIAA DBF

about.title: Systems-minded, test-driven, and comfortable close to the hardware.
about.lede: I am most energized by engineering problems that demand rigor across analysis, prototyping, verification, and team coordination. I enjoy turning broad mission goals into requirements, architectures, experiments, and decisions that stand up under real operating constraints.
about.workingStyleTitle: I like engineering environments where analysis and execution have to agree.
workingStyleParagraphs: My strongest work happens in multidisciplinary teams where propulsion, controls, structures, manufacturing, and operations all have to connect. I am comfortable contributing at both the system level and the test-bench level, whether that means trade studies, documentation, validation planning, or hands-on build work.

I care a lot about engineering judgment. To me, that means requirements traceability, safety margins, manufacturability, and making sure the design is honest about the environment it has to survive in.
recruiterNotes: Propulsion, systems engineering, and flight-test experience across aircraft and rocketry projects
Published and presented technical work through AIAA forums and regional conferences
Leadership experience as Chief Engineer, team president, mentor, and teaching assistant
Brings analysis, documentation, testing discipline, and hands-on fabrication together

education.title: B.S. in Aerospace Engineering, Minor in Computer Science
education.description: Saint Louis University, St. Louis, MO. GPA: 3.9/4.0 with advanced work in aerodynamics, propulsion, structures, controls, astrodynamics, CFD, databases, scientific programming, and data structures.

education.title: Research and Technical Teaching
education.description: Worked across data center cooling research, collaborative haptics prototyping, and teaching support in thermodynamics, fluid dynamics, SolidWorks, labs, and experimental analysis.

education.title: Leadership Through Build Teams
education.description: Held progressive technical leadership roles in AIAA Design/Build/Fly and rocket propulsion teams spanning manufacturing, subsystem leadership, testing, safety, and chief engineering.

about.quote: Good engineering is not just elegant on paper. It survives testing, constraints, and the handoff to the people who have to trust it.
about.quoteBody: That standard shapes how I approach propulsion studies, verification planning, flight operations, manufacturing tradeoffs, and technical communication.

interests.title: I am drawn to engineering where performance has consequences.
interests.lede: The work I keep returning to sits at the intersection of aerospace systems, testing, controls, thermal analysis, and mission-driven design. I am especially interested in engineering environments where uncertainty has to be reduced through analysis and disciplined verification.

cards.title: Sizing the architecture, not just the component.
cards.description: I am interested in how propulsion, power distribution, and mission energy models interact across real operating phases, constraints, and failure margins.

cards.title: Let the evidence shape the design.
cards.description: I enjoy designing test plans, instrumentation strategies, and data reduction workflows that expose what a system is really doing before decisions get locked in.

cards.title: Engineering gets better when subsystems talk to each other.
cards.description: I like programs where structures, controls, manufacturing, software, and operations all have to line up, because that is where strong systems thinking becomes visible.

favorites: Technical leadership on cross-functional build teams
outsideParagraphs: Outside of class and formal project work, I stay interested in aircraft systems, mission architecture, robotics, cooling systems, and the practical engineering tradeoffs behind high-performance hardware.
That is also why this portfolio is structured more like a technical studio than a generic student site. I want it to feel closer to a systems review than a resume pasted onto the web.

projects.title: Selected work in propulsion, flight systems, research, and build leadership.
projects.lede: These projects show how I work across system architecture, feasibility analysis, testing, fabrication, and technical coordination. The focus is on engineering decisions, validation, and what it took to make the work credible.

items.title: HEART: Hybrid-Electric Aircraft for Rapid Organ Transportation
items.description: Served as Propulsion Lead on a hybrid-electric VTOL UAV concept and prototype, translating mission requirements into propulsion architecture, energy models, and testable design decisions.
bullets: Built MATLAB mission energy and power models across VTOL, hover, cruise, descent, and reserve phases with efficiency losses and design margins included
Performed propulsion and energy system sizing that showed an all-electric COTS architecture was infeasible under battery energy-density and C-rating constraints
Defined high-voltage DC power distribution, generator-battery power sharing, and battery buffering strategy for high-power flight phases
Designed wind-tunnel testing to compare cyclic pitch, collective pitch, and differential thrust control authority in hover and transition regimes
Supported flight testing of the tilt-wing prototype through hover, wing transition, and sustained forward flight
items.role: Propulsion lead, systems definition, testing and validation

items.title: Competition Aircraft Program Leadership
items.description: Led technical direction for Saint Louis University's Design/Build/Fly team, guiding aircraft design, propulsion verification, test readiness, and cross-team execution.
bullets: Directed system-level design reviews for a 30-member team and coordinated technical progress across six subsystems
Translated competition rules into quantitative weight, power, mission, and performance requirements
Led propulsion trade studies, thrust characterization, subsystem validation, and pre-flight verification procedures
Built a project-management framework with milestone tracking, risk visibility, and manufacturing schedule alignment
Helped grow membership by 130 percent and available funding by over 100 percent through recruitment, outreach, and operational leadership
items.role: President, Chief Engineer, former propulsion and testing lead

items.title: Recovery and Safety Systems for Competitive High-Power Rocketry
items.description: Led recovery and safety work for a Spaceport America Cup rocket program, combining design analysis, test validation, documentation, and operational safety discipline.
bullets: Designed and optimized a parachute recovery system through analytical modeling, ground tests, and flight validation, earning a maximum recovery score
Co-authored a technical paper published at AIAA SciTech 2025 based on recovery system design, analysis, and testing
Developed and enforced manufacturing and test safety procedures for energetic-material workflows while maintaining a 100 percent safety record
Integrated avionics, payload bays, telemetry hardware, and carbon-fiber structural elements to support reliable recovery operations

items.title: Applied Research in Thermal Systems and Haptic Devices
items.description: Worked across data center cooling research and wearable haptics prototyping, using modeling, experimentation, and user-centered iteration to improve technical decisions.
bullets: Conducted comparative and modular thermodynamic analysis of data-center cooling architectures including air, cold-plate liquid, and immersion cooling
Built CAD-modeled wearable prototypes, validated them through three user-test cycles with 10 plus participants, and reduced donning time by 48 percent
Designed circuits and Arduino-based control logic for tactile feedback, achieving 95 percent detection accuracy and cutting development time in half
Balanced analytical work with manufacturability, accessibility, and usability in early-stage prototype development

contact.title: Open to full-time engineering work with technical depth.
contact.lede: I am looking for opportunities where systems thinking, analysis, testing, and hands-on engineering all matter, especially on teams building credible aerospace, research, robotics, or high-performance hardware systems.
contact.reachOutTitle: Let's talk about the systems your team is building.
contact.reachOutBody: If your team values rigorous engineering, thoughtful validation, and people who can move between analysis, documentation, testing, and build execution, I would be glad to connect.
